main.description: The party's signed assertion that work (or a milestone) is delivered, anchored to a specific git commit — the primary, INDEPENDENTLY-TESTABLE proof: anyone can fetch the sha and run it, with no trust in the assertion. Git is treated as untrusted hosting (the owner can force-push or delete it), so the durable claim is the sha recorded HERE and witnessed on-protocol — re-stated in the patron's acceptance/confirmation and held by trusted third parties (org.buildguild.witness). evidence[] carries the non-git tail (deploy link, design file). Author is the party (repo owner). Written to the party's repo.

agreement.description: Optional strongRef to the org.buildguild.acceptance, so delivery is judged against what was AGREED, not just the advert.

milestone.description: Optional milestone label this delivery satisfies (matches a milestone on the agreed offer).

source.description: The git anchor — what is being delivered, as content-addressed bytes.

repo.description: Clone URI where the commit can be fetched (untrusted/availability only; may later disappear).

commit.description: Git commit sha (hex) — the immutable, independently-checkable anchor. Pin the COMMIT, never a branch.

treeHash.description: Optional git tree sha — the content fingerprint, stable across history rewrites.

ref.description: Optional human ref the commit was on (tag/branch), for convenience only.

path.description: Optional sub-path within the repo that is the deliverable.

evidence.description: Optional non-git proof an auditor can check (deploy URL, content hash, etc.).
